newsitem.title: UK: Marston shares up on profit rise, outlook.
newsitem.headline: Marston shares up on profit rise, outlook.

text.p: Shares in regional brewer Marston, Thompson & Evershed Plc rose on Tuesday after the company reported an increase in annual profits and a strong start to the current fiscal year.
By 0920 GMT, the stock traded eight pence higher at 278-1/2p, still well below its year high of 318p touched in January.
Profits rose 8.2 percent to 29.5 million stg for the year ending March 29 and the total dividend edged up to 8.03 pence per share from 7.30 pence per share the previous year.
The company said there was a "feel-good" factor among consumers that had contributed to an encouraging start to the current fiscal year.
